### 1 — Scene
A meal of what appears to be thick-crust cheese-and-tomato pizza, leafy salad with black olives, and cooked broccoli with cherry tomatoes. The baked main’s exact identity is somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately 26–28 cm across. Using a **26 cm equivalent circular diameter** for the requested area calculation:
**3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: cheese-and-tomato pizza, mixed salad leaves, black olives, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and a light glossy dressing/oil coating. Cheese and tomato sauce are included in the pizza estimate.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage percentages refer to separate footprints; the dressing coats existing food rather than adding coverage.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese-and-tomato pizza | 27% | 143 × 1.6 = 229 ml | 0.95 | 217 g | 250 | 543 kcal |
| Mixed salad leaves | 20% | 106 × 2.5 = 265 ml | 0.15 | 40 g | 20 | 8 kcal |
| Black olives | 1% | 5.3 × 1.5 = 8 ml | 0.7 | 6 g | 115 | 7 kcal |
| Broccoli | 10% | 53 × 2.5 = 133 ml | 0.6 | 80 g | 35 | 28 kcal |
| Cherry tomatoes | 7% | 37 × 1.8 = 67 ml | 0.6 | 40 g | 18 | 7 kcal |
| Oil/light dressing | Coating | Approximately 5 ml | 0.9 | 5 g | 880 | 44 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 27 + 20 + 1 + 10 + 7 = **65%**, consistent with the substantial empty section of plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **about 390 g and 640 kcal**. This is plausible for a moderately thick pizza portion with lightweight salad and a small vegetable side. The biggest uncertainties are the baked main’s thickness and the amount of oil.
